criteria.title: Independent entry

intent.request: Native Quick Panel defaults to the A search launcher outside regular app chrome while retaining existing tools and the configured opt-in shortcut.

criteria.method: Run the registered checks and inspect the current-build native route, selected identity and nested dismissal where applicable. Execute the registered isolated native suite and the named unit checks; bind both unit and e2e evidence to the clause. The read-only results-ledger probe verifies the frozen native acceptance run passed; it never substitutes for running the tests. Do not dispatch native Playwright through the Vitest-only tests check router. Required unit check: apps/operator/lib/quick-panel-escape.test.tsx. The latest recorded native run at the pinned commit must pass and have worktree_dirty=false; a later failure or dirty run invalidates an earlier pass. Governing scope and reuse decision: quick-access-search-launcher-2026-10-26#D-003. Required shortcut proof: run the existing docs_search::tests:: Cargo cases in papercusp-desktop/src-tauri/src/docs_search.rs, including OFF/default/preset roundtrip and failed/successful rebind, and the private PAPERCUSP_HOME regression; bind the resulting Cargo ledger evidence alongside unit and e2e proof. The native spec's first entry must be a real Ctrl+Shift+K from the isolated external xterm through the native startup shortcut registrar.
criteria.driftMarkers: The native shortcut opens a regular app route, duplicates the popup, or defaults to Prompts.

probe.sql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT status = 'pass' AND worktree_dirty = FALSE FROM harness_shared.test_runs WHERE harness_slug = 'papercusp' AND framework = 'playwright' AND source = 'local' AND file_path LIKE '%quick-access.native.spec.mts' AND commit_sha = '2d61978ba573da1a7cfeeb6ccfc6c89c5a88fc91' AND started_at > TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-26T18:00:00Z' ORDER BY finished_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1), FALSE) AS passed
